sources.entry: Houndarr - Scheduled backlog searches for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr and Whisparr. Works through missing and cutoff-unmet items in small rate-limited batches with per-item cooldowns and hourly caps, to avoid overloading indexers. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Houndarr is a self-hosted Docker service that slowly and politely triggers searches in Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr and Whisparr for missing or cutoff-unmet library items.
summary.what_it_does: Houndarr works through the backlog of items your *arr instances report as missing or below quality cutoff, in small configurable batches with sleep intervals between cycles. It applies per-item cooldowns and a per-instance hourly API cap to avoid overloading indexers. A download-queue backpressure gate skips cycles when the queue is full, and optional per-instance time windows limit when searches run. It offers a web UI with a live dashboard, run-now buttons, and a filterable log viewer. Per the README, its only network activity is read-only REST calls and search commands to the configured *arr instances; it states it has no telemetry.
use_cases: search for missing movies, episodes, albums or books automatically
upgrade items below quality cutoff in Radarr or Sonarr
avoid indexer bans from Search All Missing
rate-limited backlog searching for a media library
schedule missing-media searches during set hours
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml using image ghcr.io/av1155/houndarr:latest with port 8877 and a ./data volume
Open http://<host>:8877 and create the admin account on the setup screen
Alternatively use docker run with -p 8877:8877 and -v /path/to/data:/data
notable: Small batches, per-item cooldowns and hourly caps to protect indexer API limits
Per-instance search order: random or chronological
Instance API keys encrypted at rest with Fernet and never sent back to the browser
Runs as a single Docker container, non-root after PUID/PGID remapping
Helm chart available per the README links
caveats: Only works alongside existing Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr or Whisparr instances
Single admin account only; no multi-user support
Does not manage download clients, Prowlarr or indexers
